LESSON: WRITING 1.5.1 HAND WRITING: 1.5.2 BRAILLE LEGIBILITY AND NEATNESS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.5: Writing 1.5.1 Hand writing: 1.5.2 braille Legibility and Neatness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 1.5.1 Hand writing: 1.5.2 braille Legibility and Neatness, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we learn to write legibly and clearly? 2. How can you make your hand/braille writing presentable?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 1.5.1 Hand writing: 1.5.2 braille Legibility and Neatness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to Learn: A learner collaborates with peers to write clearly and spell words correctly.

Values:
● Respect: A learner provide feedback respectfully and positively.

● Social justice: A learners review each other’s written work.

Link to other subjects:

Language subjects; legible and neat handwriting is an essential skill for these subjects

Suggested Learning Resources

● Braille work cards, braille charts, braille machines and braille papers.
